name: feature.discovery.nodes
description: Discovery feature node pack (MERCH-C chat-drivability) — nodes over the ctx.features.discovery surface. `search` runs faceted product search; `collection-upsert` authors a manual/dynamic collection; `merch-rule-upsert` authors a pin/boost/bury/hide rule. Both writes CREATE a new row on every call (they are not upserts), so they are role:'side-effect' and :fork serves the recorded output (ADR 1025 D2). A run-authored merch rule lands INACTIVE for a human to activate; a collection lands live. `search` is a read and re-executes on replay.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Discovery Search
nodes.description: Faceted product search (optional collection scope) over ctx.features.discovery. A read (re-executes on replay). Inputs: orgId, q?, collectionId?.

nodes.label: Discovery Collection Upsert
nodes.description: Creates a NEW collection on every call — manual (productIds) or dynamic (rule by category/tag/price). Inputs: orgId, name, type, productIds?|rule?.

nodes.label: Discovery Merch-Rule Upsert
nodes.description: Creates a NEW merchandising rule (pin/boost/bury/hide over a query/collection scope) with optional holdout, INACTIVE until a human activates it. Inputs: orgId, name, scope, actions:[…], holdoutPct?.
